preservation_condition: Preserved stages remain valid subject to target identity, target-versus-comparable role, and lineage validation at the forecast control point.
mandatory_validation_scope: Verify the exact approved pre-Collector target universe identity and count.
Verify every forecast target product is a member of the approved pre-Collector universe.
Verify Collector products appear only as explicitly typed comparable-reference rows.
Reject any forecast target authority path containing collector_v1 or secret_lair.
Verify input lineage from pre-Collector target through comparable selection, model route, and uncertainty evidence.
Classify each of the eight forecast artifacts as authoritative evidence, reusable architecture requiring rebinding, or invalid output.
Maintain quarantine on all outputs from the cross-lane substitution range unless individually rebound and recertified.
fail_closed_controls: Validation must fail if a Collector product is present as a forecast target.
Validation must fail if a target product is absent from the approved pre-Collector universe authority.
Validation must fail if target and comparable product roles are not explicitly separated.
Validation must fail if the target universe identity or count changes without a new owner-approved decision.
Validation must fail if an artifact cannot prove its target authority and dependency lineage.
No validation result may authorize forecast execution automatically.
change_control: Any change to the approved restart stage, preserved stages, target universe, target/comparable roles, or authorization state requires a new owner-approved versioned decision and recertification.
